data.title: Al-Shifa Hospital in Unaizah Accredited as Age-Friendly Health Facility
data.content:
Buraidah, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Al-Shifa Hospital in Unaizah, part of the Qassim Health Cluster, has received accreditation as an "Age-Friendly Health Facility" after meeting the required standards. The accreditation reflects its commitment to improving healthcare services for older adults. It also recognizes the hospital's efforts to provide a safe, accessible environment that meets their specific health needs.
    The Qassim Health Cluster said the hospital met several criteria for age-friendly healthcare. These include facilitating access to services, improving care quality, and ensuring patient safety and comfort throughout treatment. The hospital has also worked to enhance healthcare professionals' capabilities to address the needs of older adults.
    The cluster noted that the accreditation reflects its commitment to improving healthcare services and facilities for older adults. These efforts aim to improve the quality of care and better meet their needs. They also align with the objectives of the Health Sector Transformation Program, Saudi Vision 2030, and the Saudi healthcare system.
    -- SPA
